title: IllustratedMessage
description: Fiori illustrated message: illustration + title + subtitle + actions in the Scene / Dialog / Spot / Dot / Base designs, auto-sized by the container (ui5-illustrated-message). Ships with @fiori/illustrations-core (NoData, NoSearchResults, UnableToLoad, Tent, …); add more with @fiori/illustration-<name> or @fiori/illustration-tnt-<name>.

usage.summary: Explain an empty, unavailable or completed state with an illustration and a useful next step.
useWhen: Help users understand why content is empty or unavailable, or what a completed task means.
Pair a solution-oriented title and description with a relevant illustration and recovery or next-step actions.
Pass illustration and choose design="Auto" for container sizing; supply action children except when design="Base" hides them.

avoidWhen.when: Explain in-page context while the surrounding content remains usable.
Confirm a completed action briefly without requiring a response.
Start from a ready-made page demonstrating no-data, no-results and loading-failure patterns.
An operation is still running and its completion percentage is unknown.
